reviews.name: Jules M.
reviews.body: The frosting is cream cheese, not that sugary whipped stuff. Took these to my sister's garden party and they were gone before the drinks came out.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.body: My go-to. The crumb is genuinely velvet — soft without being wet, which is where most red velvet falls apart.

reviews.name: Dan R.
reviews.body: Great flavor, though a touch sweeter than I'd like. Pairs well with the lemon one if you're building a box.

pairsWith.why: keeps a sweet box from cloying

reviews.name: Marcus T.
reviews.body: You can actually taste the browned butter — nutty and a little savory underneath. Most chocolate chip cookies are just sugar with chips in.

reviews.name: Elena K.
reviews.body: Still soft on day two, which almost never happens. The sea salt on top does a lot of work.

reviews.name: Chris B.
reviews.body: Solid and reliable. I wish the chocolate pools were a bit bigger but no real complaints.

pairsWith.why: keeps a butter-forward box from flattening

reviews.name: Amara O.
reviews.body: Sharp, not artificial. It tastes like actual lemons rather than lemon flavoring, and the glaze cracks properly when you bite it.

reviews.name: Tom W.
reviews.body: The one I order after a heavy meal. Light enough that it doesn't sit on you.

reviews.name: Sofia L.
reviews.body: Bought a box for the office and this was the first to go. Even the people who 'don't like sweet things' had one.

reviews.name: Nina P.
reviews.body: Speculoos done properly — the caramel is burnt just enough to stop it being cloying. Dense in the good way.

reviews.name: Owen H.
reviews.body: Rich, so one is plenty. Very good with coffee, a bit much on its own.

reviews.name: Grace M.
reviews.body: My husband asks for this one specifically. The butterscotch actually tastes like butterscotch and not just brown sugar.

pairsWith.why: caramel and browned butter run together

reviews.name: Jules M.
reviews.body: Ordered this for a birthday and it was the centerpiece. Real strawberries, and the cream isn't over-sweetened.

reviews.name: Ben A.
reviews.body: The shortcake layer holds up instead of going soggy, which is the whole problem with strawberry desserts.

reviews.name: Hana S.
reviews.body: Beautiful and it photographs well. Slightly messy to eat standing up at a party, so plan for plates.

reviews.name: Devon C.
reviews.body: Properly dark. The ganache center is still molten in the middle and it is not sweet, which is rare and welcome.

reviews.name: Rita J.
reviews.body: If you like dark chocolate this is the one. I pair it with the lemon to cut through.

reviews.name: Alex F.
reviews.body: Very rich — I split one. Cocoa nibs on top add a nice bitter crunch.

pairsWith.why: cuts the fudge with something sharp
berry lifts a heavy cocoa box

weeklyMenu.name: Salted Honey Cake
weeklyMenu.blurb: Whipped honey cream · flaky sea salt

reviews.name: Maya L.
reviews.body: The honey flavor is warm and clear, and the salt keeps the cream from becoming too sweet.

reviews.name: Jon P.
reviews.body: Soft cake, light frosting, exactly the kind of dessert I want with coffee.

pairsWith.why: honey and lemon, the obvious pair
two toasty flavors with salt in common

weeklyMenu.name: Raspberry Oat Crumble
weeklyMenu.blurb: Tart raspberry jam · brown sugar oat topping

reviews.name: Leah S.
reviews.body: Bright raspberry and a genuinely crisp oat topping. It is not overly sweet.

reviews.name: Noah K.
reviews.body: This disappeared first from our shared box. The tart filling makes it very easy to keep eating.

pairsWith.why: oat crumble and honey belong together

reviews.name: Hana W.
reviews.body: Proper carrot cake, not a muffin pretending. The walnut on top is toasted, which is the detail most places skip.

reviews.name: Ben O.
reviews.body: Moist, well spiced, generous on the frosting. I'd take it slightly less sweet.

reviews.name: Lucia F.
reviews.body: Real espresso, real mascarpone. Served cold and it holds its layers all the way down the cup.

reviews.name: Omar H.
reviews.body: Ordered two for a dinner and ended up hiding one for myself. No regrets.

pairsWith.why: coffee and speculoos, the café pair

reviews.name: Renee C.
reviews.body: Sharp enough to make you blink, which is how key lime should be. Crust stays crisp.

reviews.name: Theo K.
reviews.body: Bright and clean. Would love a little more whipped cream on top.

reviews.name: Grace L.
reviews.body: Tastes like the one my grandmother made, wafers gone soft in the right way.

reviews.name: Dev P.
reviews.body: Big portion, very comforting. Best eaten the same day.

pairsWith.why: adds a tart edge to the cream

reviews.name: Mina S.
reviews.body: Shatters when you bite it and the pistachio cream is the real green kind, not dyed.

reviews.name: Carlos R.
reviews.body: The best thing on the menu, full stop. Get here before eleven or it's gone.

reviews.name: Jamal T.
reviews.body: Soft all the way to the center, glaze still a little warm when I picked it up.

reviews.name: Elise N.
reviews.body: Great roll. Sweet, so pair it with something sharp.

reviews.name: Kai M.
reviews.body: Fudgy, not cakey. The caramel is ribboned through rather than a puddle on top.

reviews.name: Sofia A.
reviews.body: Took a box to the office and had to send a photo of the empty tray by noon.

weeklyMenu.name: Vanilla Bean Macarons
weeklyMenu.blurb: Almond shells · vanilla bean ganache · set of 3

reviews.name: Noor B.
reviews.body: Feet on the shells, chewy inside, and you can see the vanilla seeds in the ganache.

reviews.name: Wes D.
reviews.body: Delicate and pretty. Three is a tease, I wanted six.

pairsWith.why: adds fruit to a vanilla box

reviews.name: Yuki T.
reviews.body: Actual ceremonial-grade matcha flavor, grassy rather than sweet. Plant-based and you genuinely cannot tell.

reviews.name: Marco D.
reviews.body: Coconut is subtle, which I liked. If you want a strong coconut hit this isn't it, but the balance is good.

reviews.name: Leah B.
reviews.body: Dairy-free and it doesn't taste like a compromise. My daughter can't have dairy and she picks this every time.

reviews.name: Isabel R.
reviews.body: Fig and almond is an underrated pairing and this nails it. Barely sweet, more like something you'd get after dinner.

reviews.name: Paul G.
reviews.body: The frangipane is proper — dense, nutty, not the gluey kind. Worth the extra dollar.

reviews.name: Mira K.
reviews.body: Lovely but it does contain almonds, obviously, so not one for a mixed group with nut allergies.

reviews.name: Priya V.
reviews.body: Crisp edge, soft middle, and nobody at the table guessed it was plant-based.

reviews.name: Milo J.
reviews.body: Good cookie. A little more salt would push it to five.

pairsWith.why: citrus against the chocolate, both plant-based

reviews.name: Anika R.
reviews.body: Silky and light. The mango on top is actual fruit, not syrup.

reviews.name: Leo G.
reviews.body: Refreshing after a heavy meal. Wish the cup were bigger.

pairsWith.why: two coconut bases, one grassy, one fruity

reviews.name: Tess H.
reviews.body: Deep, dark and dense. You cannot taste the avocado, only the texture it gives.

reviews.name: Rafael M.
reviews.body: Very rich, one is plenty. Great for someone avoiding dairy.

reviews.name: Ivy C.
reviews.body: Tender crumb from the olive oil and a glaze with real lemon bite.

reviews.name: Sam O.
reviews.body: Solid morning slice. Goes with coffee better than most things here.

pairsWith.why: adds richness to a light loaf

reviews.name: Dana K.
reviews.body: Chewy, salty-sweet, and the peanut flavor is roasted rather than raw.

reviews.name: Aaron F.
reviews.body: My kids demolished these. Dense, so one goes a long way.

reviews.name: Ruth E.
reviews.body: Crust flakes like it was made with butter. Apples still have some bite.

reviews.name: Nate S.
reviews.body: Perfect car snack, no fork required. Ordered again the next week.

pairsWith.why: apple pie and a chocolate chip cookie

eventMenus.name: Harvest Festival
eventMenus.blurb: Brown sugar, spiced pear and maple pecan, built for cool evenings.

reviews.name: Kara W.
reviews.body: Real maple, not syrup flavoring, and the pecans stay crisp.

reviews.name: Joel M.
reviews.body: Sweet but the pecan bitterness balances it. Very autumn.

pairsWith.why: pecan and pear, the harvest pair

reviews.name: Tess H.
reviews.body: The pastry shatters properly and the pear isn't mushy.

reviews.name: Raj P.
reviews.body: Spicing is restrained — you can still taste the fruit.

reviews.name: Molly F.
reviews.body: Tastes like the ones from an orchard. The cinnamon sugar is generous.

reviews.name: Evan S.
reviews.body: Best eaten same day. Still good the next morning but not the same.

reviews.name: Molly B.
reviews.body: The gingersnap crust is the trick. Not too sweet, properly spiced.

reviews.name: Chris D.
reviews.body: Creamy and autumnal. I'd like it back every year.

reviews.name: Farah N.
reviews.body: Thin apple slices fanned out like a bakery window. The caramel has salt, thank goodness.

reviews.name: Owen P.
reviews.body: Good tart. Apples could be a touch softer.

pairsWith.why: caramel apple next to browned butter

eventMenus.name: Holiday Table
eventMenus.blurb: Gift towers and dessert tables sized for a full house.

reviews.name: Dana L.
reviews.body: Snaps cleanly and the peppermint is cooling rather than toothpasty.

reviews.name: Nate K.
reviews.body: Very sweet. Good in small pieces with coffee.

reviews.name: Clara V.
reviews.body: Showstopper for the table. The ganache is dark enough to offset the sponge.

reviews.name: Sam O.
reviews.body: Ordered for twelve people and it sliced beautifully.

reviews.name: Hugo B.
reviews.body: Proper molasses depth and a real ginger burn at the end.

reviews.name: Anita D.
reviews.body: Warming and not too sweet. I'd like a touch more spice.

reviews.name: Holly R.
reviews.body: Nutmeg custard piped generously, choux still crisp. Tastes like the season.

reviews.name: Sanjay M.
reviews.body: Lovely, if you like eggnog. I do.

reviews.name: Beth A.
reviews.body: Crumbly in the right way and the orange glaze keeps it from being dry.

reviews.name: Victor L.
reviews.body: A morning scone that works at dessert too. Tart cranberries.

eventMenus.name: Lunar New Year
eventMenus.blurb: Red bean, sesame and citrus in a share-first gift format.

reviews.name: Wei L.
reviews.body: The lotus paste is smooth and not grainy, which is the giveaway for a good one.

reviews.name: Fiona C.
reviews.body: Gave these as gifts and they were very well received.

reviews.name: Jin H.
reviews.body: Chewy outside, warm sesame inside. Exactly right.

reviews.name: Nora A.
reviews.body: Lovely texture. Best eaten fresh rather than saved.

reviews.name: Ravi S.
reviews.body: Short, crumbly and toasty. Reminds me of the bakery ones growing up.

reviews.name: Gina T.
reviews.body: Simple and good. Not flashy, just well made.

items.name: Red Bean Pillow Bun
items.blurb: Steamed milk bun · sweet red bean

reviews.name: Wei Z.
reviews.body: Pillowy, warm, red bean not too sweet. My grandmother approved, which is rare.

reviews.name: Amy T.
reviews.body: Soft and comforting. Best warm.

reviews.name: Jin K.
reviews.body: Light as the name says. The mandarin curd is fragrant rather than sour.

reviews.name: Elena V.
reviews.body: Beautiful, and no dairy so my sister could have it too.

eventMenus.name: Graduation Season
eventMenus.blurb: Colorway-matched boxes for school colors and big group orders.

reviews.name: Beth N.
reviews.body: The confetti doesn't bleed into the crumb, so it still looks sharp when sliced.

reviews.name: Omar Y.
reviews.body: Ordered for a graduation and it did the job — fun without being childish.

reviews.name: Lucy P.
reviews.body: Adorable and the cocoa is actually dark, so adults ate them too.

reviews.name: Theo R.
reviews.body: Cute. The gold dust does transfer onto fingers a bit.

pairsWith.why: cookie and cake for the table

reviews.name: Ada M.
reviews.body: Proper curd, properly sharp. The shortbread base doesn't go soft.

reviews.name: Kyle J.
reviews.body: My favorite of the spring menu. I order two.

pairsWith.why: lemon bar and a chocolate cookie

items.name: Celebration Cake Pops
items.blurb: Vanilla cake · candy shell · set of 3

reviews.name: Tara S.
reviews.body: School colors on request and they held up in a warm car. Kids went feral.

reviews.name: Miguel A.
reviews.body: Cute and easy to hand out. Sweet, as expected.

pairsWith.why: pops and cookies for a crowd

reviews.name: Zoe W.
reviews.body: The shimmer is edible glitter, not sugar crystals, so it photographs like a dream.

reviews.name: Paul H.
reviews.body: Very good vanilla cupcake dressed up for the occasion.

smartOffers.title: Complete the six-count, up to 15% off
smartOffers.detail: Fill all six slots and the box drops to the bundle price. Three or more flavors gets the full 15%.
smartOffers.reason: Six singles cost more than one box, so we would rather you fill it.

smartOffers.label: Because this is a big box
smartOffers.title: Party Box: free flavor flight
smartOffers.detail: Twelve or more treats and we add a six-piece flavor flight to the order, free.
smartOffers.reason: Past a dozen you are feeding a room, and the flight helps people choose.

smartOffers.label: Because it's in season
smartOffers.title: $1.50 off every seasonal treat
smartOffers.detail: Any item from the live seasonal menu is $1.50 off while the menu runs.
smartOffers.reason: Seasonal items run for weeks, not months. The launch price gets them tried.

smartOffers.label: Because you reorder
smartOffers.title: Your usual, 15% off
smartOffers.detail: Four or more of a flavor you keep coming back for, and the whole box takes 15% off.

smartOffers.label: Because you're close
smartOffers.title: Free delivery over $45
smartOffers.detail: Choose delivery at checkout and a box over $45 ships free. Otherwise delivery is $6.95.
smartOffers.reason: Applied on its own at checkout. Nothing to enter.

plans.pitch: Two of the week's new flavors, every Thursday.

plans.name: The Table
plans.pitch: A six-count box sized for a household, with AI picking the mix.

plans.name: The Host
plans.pitch: For the person who always volunteers to bring dessert.

reviews.name: Jules M.
reviews.body: The concierge picked the Strawberry Shortcake for my sister's garden party and it was the centerpiece. Gone in minutes.

reviews.name: Ari K.
reviews.body: Bright, buttery, not too sweet. The Lemon Glaze Cloud is my new personality.

reviews.name: Riley S.
reviews.body: Ordered by voice on the drive home and it was boxed and waiting. Genuinely felt like magic.

reviews.name: Dev P.
reviews.body: Great plant-based options, which is rare. Would love one more nut-free pick in the rotation.

reviewSummary.headline: What 1,284 people keep saying
reviewSummary.watchout: Most common request: more nut-free options in the weekly rotation.

agents.blurb: Reads taste history, occasion and who's eating, then shortlists from the live menu.

agents.name: Offers Agent

agents.name: Orders Agent
agents.blurb: Conversational and voice ordering, plus live status from oven to counter.

agents.name: Support Agent
agents.blurb: Allergen questions, substitutions and remakes, with a human handoff when it matters.

agents.name: Party Planner Agent
agents.blurb: Turns a headcount and a vibe into a spread that actually feeds the room.

agents.name: Inventory Agent
agents.blurb: Franchise-to-HQ supply ordering, with reorder points tuned per location.
